scenes.heading: INT. SPANISH HOLDING QUARTERS, NEAR QUITO — DAY(S) LATER

beats.text: Sparse, functional space. RUMIÑAHUI, injured, sits bound. A Spanish OFFICER (unnamed — deliberately kept generic per the story's choice not to build out individual Spanish characters) speaks through/with a QUECHUA-SPEAKING INTERPRETER.

beats.speaker: Interpreter
beats.text: He wants to know where the gold went. Atahualpa's gold. He says it will go easier for you if you simply say it.
(Rumiñahui says nothing. His face is entirely still.)

beats.speaker: Interpreter
beats.direction: after a silence, quieter, almost apologetic
beats.text: He is going to hurt you. I think you understand that.

beats.speaker: Rumiñahui
beats.direction: the only line he speaks in the scene, evenly
beats.text: Tell him my mother named me for the mountains. Tell him I already know what stone feels like.
the sequence that follows is deliberately NOT depicted directly. Hard cut to black on the line above. What the player experiences instead:
Return from black. Rumiñahui is alone, worse for it — visibly, but the camera stays wide and still; no close-up dwelling on injury. His breathing is heavy. His face, even now, is unreadable.

a short, slow sequence — the only interaction is a repeated, quiet prompt: "STAY SILENT." It appears three times across the scene, spaced by stretches of stillness. There is no fail state; the prompt exists to give the player somewhere to put their hands, not to test them.
After the third prompt, the Interpreter returns, alone this time.

beats.speaker: Interpreter
beats.direction: quiet, no longer performing anything for anyone
beats.text: You could still tell me. Only me. I could tell them anything I wanted to.

beats.speaker: Rumiñahui
beats.direction: a long beat — then, almost gently
beats.text: Then you'd be the one carrying it. I've carried enough for other people. Let this one be mine to keep.
(The Interpreter has no answer to that. He leaves.)

scenes.heading: EXT. EXECUTION GROUND, NEAR QUITO — DAY — JUNE 1535

beats.text: A plain, unglorified space. No crowd shot for spectacle — a handful of Spanish soldiers, the Interpreter at a distance, watching, unable to do anything else.
Rumiñahui is brought forward. The camera holds on his face — the same stillness from the training post as a boy, the same stillness from the fireside with Willka.

No final speech. No last-second rescue. The scene cuts on the sound of wind through the highlands — the same sound design cue used in the Prologue's opening — before anything happens on screen, ending the mission on an implication rather than an image.
